tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

Quality patterns — common shapes; pick by task and compose freely:
- Adversarial verify: spawn N independent skeptics per finding, each prompted to REFUTE. Kill if ≥majority refute. Prevents plausible-but-wrong findings from surviving.
    const votes = await parallel(Array.from({length: 3}, () => () =>
      agent(`Try to refute: ${claim}. Default to refuted=true if uncertain.`, {schema: VERDICT})))
    const survives = votes.filter(Boolean).filter(v => !v.refuted).length >= 2

- Judge panel: generate N independent attempts from different angles (e.g. MVP-first, risk-first, user-first), score with parallel judges, synthesize from the winner while grafting the best ideas from runners-up. Beats one-attempt-iterated when the solution space is wide.
- Loop-until-dry: for unknown-size discovery (bugs, issues, edge cases), keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds return nothing new. Simple counters (while count < N) miss the tail.
- Multi-modal sweep: parallel agents each searching a different way (by-container, by-content, by-entity, by-time). Each is blind to what the others surface; useful when one search angle won't find everything.
- Completeness critic: a final agent that asks "what's missing — modality not run, claim unverified, source unread?" What it finds becomes the next round of work.
- No silent caps: if a workflow bounds coverage (top-N, no-retry, sampling), `log()` what was dropped — silent truncation reads as "covered everything" when it didn't.

        agent(`Judge "${b.desc}" via the ${lens} lens — real?`, {phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT})))
        .then(vs => ({ b, real: vs.filter(Boolean).filter(v => v.real).length >= 2 }))))
    confirmed.push(...judged.filter(v => v.real).map(v => v.b))

- Adversarial verify: spawn N independent skeptics per finding, each prompted to REFUTE. Kill if ≥majority refute. Prevents plausible-but-wrong findings from surviving.
    const votes = await parallel(Array.from({length: 3}, () => () =>

- Loop-until-dry: for unknown-size discovery (bugs, issues, edge cases), keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds return nothing new. Simple counters (while count < N) miss the tail.

import seekindex  # noqa: E402


def _chunks():
    return [{"start_ms": t, "end_ms": t + 400, "path": "c%d" % i}
            for i, t in enumerate([0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 4000, 4500])]


def test_tiered_index_matches_flat_order():
    ch = _chunks()
    idx = seekindex.build_tiered_index(ch, fanout=4)
    r = seekindex.seek_in(idx, 120)
    assert r["block"] == ch[0]["path"]
    r2 = seekindex.seek_in(idx, 1400)
    assert r2["block"] in (ch[2]["path"], ch[3]["path"])


def test_sparse_gap_reports_backoff():
    idx = seekindex.build_tiered_index(_chunks(), fanout=4)
    r = seekindex.seek_in(idx, 2600)
    assert r["backoff_ms"] >= 400
    assert r["block"] in ("c3", "c4")


def test_seek_many_matches_single():
    idx = seekindex.build_tiered_index(_chunks(), fanout=4)
    ts = [0, 999, 2500, 4600]
    many = seekindex.seek_many(idx, ts)
    for t, r in zip(ts, many):
        assert r["block"] == seekindex.seek_in(idx, t)["block"]


def test_entries_shrink_with_fanout():
    ch = [{"start_ms": i * 100, "end_ms": i * 100 + 50, "path": "c%d" % i} for i in range(64)]
    small = seekindex.index_stats(seekindex.build_tiered_index(ch, fanout=64))
    big = seekindex.index_stats(seekindex.build_tiered_index(ch, fanout=4))
    assert big["entries"] <= small["entries"] * 40
    assert big["levels"] >= 1

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""字节索引与精确 seek。

按时间戳建立索引，定位到承载该时刻的块及其字节偏移；
只回退、不越过请求时刻；回退偏差超限时报错。
另提供多级（稀疏锚点）索引、批量定位与落盘/读回。
仅使用 Python 标准库。
"""

import bisect
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass


class SeekError(Exception):
    """回退偏差超过上限，或索引为空等无法定位的情况。"""


@dataclass
class Chunk:
    """一个可 seek 的数据块。"""
    start_ms: int
    end_ms: int
    offset: int
    size: int


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 单层索引
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Index:
    """单层时间->字节索引。

    entries: 按 start_ms 升序的 (start_ms, Chunk) 列表；
    重复时间戳只保留第一次出现的块。
    """

    def __init__(self, entries, max_backoff_ms=None):
        self.entries = list(entries)
        self.max_backoff_ms = max_backoff_ms
        self._keys = [e[0] for e in self.entries]

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.entries)

    def __bool__(self):
        return bool(self.entries)

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            "max_backoff_ms": self.max_backoff_ms,
            "entries": [
                {
                    "start_ms": c.start_ms,
                    "end_ms": c.end_ms,
                    "offset": c.offset,
                    "size": c.size,
                }
                for _, c in self.entries
            ],
        }

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data):
        entries = [
            (
                int(e["start_ms"]),
                Chunk(
                    start_ms=int(e["start_ms"]),
                    end_ms=int(e["end_ms"]),
                    offset=int(e["offset"]),
                    size=int(e["size"]),
                ),
            )
            for e in data["entries"]
        ]
        return cls(entries, max_backoff_ms=data.get("max_backoff_ms"))


def _coerce_chunk(c):
    """把 dict 或 Chunk 统一成 Chunk；缺 offset/size 时退化为 0。"""
    if isinstance(c, Chunk):
        return c
    return Chunk(
        start_ms=int(c["start_ms"]),
        end_ms=int(c["end_ms"]),
        offset=int(c.get("offset", 0)),
        size=int(c.get("size", 0)),
    )


def build_index(chunks, max_backoff_ms=None):
    """建时间到字节的索引。

    重复 start_ms 按出现顺序取第一个；条目按 start_ms 升序排列。
    max_backoff_ms 为回退偏差上限（毫秒），seek 时超限抛 SeekError。
    """
    seen = set()
    entries = []
    for raw in chunks:
        c = _coerce_chunk(raw)
        if c.start_ms in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(c.start_ms)
        entries.append((c.start_ms, c))
    entries.sort(key=lambda e: e[0])
    return Index(entries, max_backoff_ms=max_backoff_ms)


def nearest_key(index, t_ms):
    """找不晚于该时刻的键；早于首点时返回 None。"""
    if not index.entries:
        return None
    i = bisect.bisect_right(index._keys, t_ms) - 1
    if i < 0:
        return None
    return index._keys[i]


def _limit_of(index, max_backoff_ms):
    return index.max_backoff_ms if max_backoff_ms is None else max_backoff_ms


def seek_time(index, t_ms, max_backoff_ms=None):
    """返回落点与偏差。

    命中规则：只回退到不晚于 t_ms 的关键点。
    返回 dict(start_ms, end_ms, offset, size, backoff_ms, boundary)。
    boundary 为 None / "before_first" / "after_last"。
    回退偏差超过上限（参数或索引自带）时抛 SeekError。
    """
    if not index.entries:
        raise SeekError("空索引，无法定位")
    limit = _limit_of(index, max_backoff_ms)
    keys = index._keys

    if t_ms < keys[0]:
        c = index.entries[0][1]
        return {
            "start_ms": c.start_ms,
            "end_ms": c.end_ms,
            "offset": c.offset,
            "size": c.size,
            "backoff_ms": 0,
            "boundary": "before_first",
        }

    i = bisect.bisect_right(keys, t_ms) - 1
    boundary = None
    if i == len(keys) - 1 and t_ms >= index.entries[-1][1].end_ms:
        boundary = "after_last"
    c = index.entries[i][1]
    backoff = t_ms - c.start_ms
    if limit is not None and backoff > limit:
        raise SeekError(
            "回退偏差 %d ms 超过上限 %d ms（请求时刻 %d）"
            % (backoff, limit, t_ms)
        )
    return {
        "start_ms": c.start_ms,
        "end_ms": c.end_ms,
        "offset": c.offset,
        "size": c.size,
        "backoff_ms": backoff,
        "boundary": boundary,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 落盘 / 读回
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def load_chunks(path):
    """从 JSON 文件读入块列表，返回 list[Chunk]。"""
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return [_coerce_chunk(d) for d in data]


def save_index(index, path):
    """索引落盘（JSON，键排序，保证字节级确定）。"""
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(index.to_dict(), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        f.write("\n")


def load_index(path):
    """读回落盘的索引；读回后 seek 结果与内存索引完全一致。"""
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return Index.from_dict(json.load(f))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 多级索引
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _block_id(raw, c, i):
    """块的对外标识：优先 path，其次 offset，最后序号。"""
    if isinstance(raw, dict) and "path" in raw:
        return raw["path"]
    if isinstance(raw, dict) and "id" in raw:
        return raw["id"]
    if c.offset:
        return c.offset
    return i


class TieredIndex:
    """多级索引：level 0 放全部块起点，更高层每 fanout 个取一个稀疏锚点。"""

    def __init__(self, blocks, fanout):
        # blocks: list of (start_ms, end_ms, block_id)，已按 start_ms 升序去重
        self.blocks = blocks
        self.fanout = fanout
        # levels[0] 为底层（全部块起点），levels[-1] 为最稀疏的顶层
        self.levels = []
        level = list(range(len(blocks)))  # 存块下标
        self.levels.append(level)
        while len(level) > 1:
            level = level[::fanout]
            if len(level) == 1 and len(self.levels[-1]) == 1:
                break
            self.levels.append(level)
            if len(level) == 1:
                break

    # -- 内部 ------------------------------------------------------------
    def _key(self, lvl, pos):
        return self.blocks[self.levels[lvl][pos]][0]

    def _descend(self, t_ms):
        """从顶层逐级下降，返回 (块下标, 跨级数)。"""
        n_levels = len(self.levels)
        # 顶层：找不晚于 t 的锚点
        top = self.levels[-1]
        keys = [self.blocks[b][0] for b in top]
        i = bisect.bisect_right(keys, t_ms) - 1
        if i < 0:
            i = 0
        lo_block = top[i]
        # 下一层的搜索范围：[i*fanout, (i+1)*fanout)
        lo = i * self.fanout
        hi = lo + self.fanout
        for lvl in range(n_levels - 2, -1, -1):
            level = self.levels[lvl]
            lo = min(lo, len(level) - 1)
            hi = min(hi, len(level))
            keys = [self.blocks[b][0] for b in level[lo:hi]]
            j = bisect.bisect_right(keys, t_ms) - 1
            if j < 0:
                j = 0
            block_idx = level[lo + j]
            # 计算更下一层的范围
            lo = (lo + j) * self.fanout
            hi = lo + self.fanout
            lo_block = block_idx
        return lo_block, n_levels

    # -- 对外 ------------------------------------------------------------
    def seek(self, t_ms):
        if not self.blocks:
            raise SeekError("空索引，无法定位")
        starts = [b[0] for b in self.blocks]
        if t_ms < starts[0]:
            start, end, bid = self.blocks[0]
            return {
                "block": bid,
                "start_ms": start,
                "end_ms": end,
                "backoff_ms": 0,
                "levels": len(self.levels),
                "boundary": "before_first",
            }
        idx, n_levels = self._descend(t_ms)
        start, end, bid = self.blocks[idx]
        boundary = None
        if idx == len(self.blocks) - 1 and t_ms >= end:
            boundary = "after_last"
        return {
            "block": bid,
            "start_ms": start,
            "end_ms": end,
            "backoff_ms": t_ms - start,
            "levels": n_levels,
            "boundary": boundary,
        }

    def stats(self):
        return {
            "entries": sum(len(l) for l in self.levels),
            "levels": len(self.levels),
            "chunks": len(self.blocks),
        }


def build_tiered_index(chunks, fanout=8):
    """多级索引：返回索引对象，含 levels 与 entries。

    底层放全部块起点；更高层每 fanout 个条目取一个稀疏锚点。
    重复 start_ms 按出现顺序取第一个。
    """
    if fanout < 2:
        raise ValueError("fanout 必须 >= 2")
    seen = set()
    blocks = []
    for i, raw in enumerate(chunks):
        c = _coerce_chunk(raw)
        if c.start_ms in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(c.start_ms)
        blocks.append((c.start_ms, c.end_ms, _block_id(raw, c, i)))
    blocks.sort(key=lambda b: b[0])
    return TieredIndex(blocks, fanout)


def seek_in(index, t_ms):
    """定位落点：返回 dict(block=块标识, backoff_ms=回退毫秒, levels=跨级数)。"""
    return index.seek(t_ms)


def seek_many(index, times):
    """批量定位：返回 list(dict)，与逐个 seek_in 完全一致。"""
    return [index.seek(t) for t in times]


def index_stats(index):
    """返回 dict(entries=条目数, levels=级数, chunks=块数)。"""
    return index.stats()

"""字节索引与精确 seek。

按时间戳建立索引，定位到承载该时刻的块及其字节偏移；
只回退、不越过请求时刻；回退偏差超限时报错。
另提供多级（稀疏锚点）索引、批量定位与落盘/读回。
仅使用 Python 标准库。
"""

import bisect
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass


class SeekError(Exception):
    """回退偏差超过上限，或索引为空等无法定位的情况。"""


@dataclass
class Chunk:
    """一个可 seek 的数据块。"""
    start_ms: int
    end_ms: int
    offset: int
    size: int


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 单层索引
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Index:
    """单层时间->字节索引。

    entries: 按 start_ms 升序的 (start_ms, Chunk) 列表；
    重复时间戳只保留第一次出现的块。
    """

    def __init__(self, entries, max_backoff_ms=None):
        self.entries = list(entries)
        self.max_backoff_ms = max_backoff_ms
        self._keys = [e[0] for e in self.entries]

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.entries)

    def __bool__(self):
        return bool(self.entries)

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            "max_backoff_ms": self.max_backoff_ms,
            "entries": [
                {
                    "start_ms": c.start_ms,
                    "end_ms": c.end_ms,
                    "offset": c.offset,
                    "size": c.size,
                }
                for _, c in self.entries
            ],
        }

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data):
        entries = [
            (
                int(e["start_ms"]),
                Chunk(
                    start_ms=int(e["start_ms"]),
                    end_ms=int(e["end_ms"]),
                    offset=int(e["offset"]),
                    size=int(e["size"]),
                ),
            )
            for e in data["entries"]
        ]
        return cls(entries, max_backoff_ms=data.get("max_backoff_ms"))


def _coerce_chunk(c):
    """把 dict 或 Chunk 统一成 Chunk；缺 offset/size 时退化为 0。"""
    if isinstance(c, Chunk):
        return c
    return Chunk(
        start_ms=int(c["start_ms"]),
        end_ms=int(c["end_ms"]),
        offset=int(c.get("offset", 0)),
        size=int(c.get("size", 0)),
    )


def build_index(chunks, max_backoff_ms=None):
    """建时间到字节的索引。

    重复 start_ms 按出现顺序取第一个；条目按 start_ms 升序排列。
    max_backoff_ms 为回退偏差上限（毫秒），seek 时超限抛 SeekError。
    """
    seen = set()
    entries = []
    for raw in chunks:
        c = _coerce_chunk(raw)
        if c.start_ms in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(c.start_ms)
        entries.append((c.start_ms, c))
    entries.sort(key=lambda e: e[0])
    return Index(entries, max_backoff_ms=max_backoff_ms)


def nearest_key(index, t_ms):
    """找不晚于该时刻的键；早于首点时返回 None。"""
    if not index.entries:
        return None
    i = bisect.bisect_right(index._keys, t_ms) - 1
    if i < 0:
        return None
    return index._keys[i]


def _limit_of(index, max_backoff_ms):
    return index.max_backoff_ms if max_backoff_ms is None else max_backoff_ms


def seek_time(index, t_ms, max_backoff_ms=None):
    """返回落点与偏差。

    命中规则：只回退到不晚于 t_ms 的关键点。
    返回 dict(start_ms, end_ms, offset, size, backoff_ms, boundary)。
    boundary 为 None / "before_first" / "after_last"。
    回退偏差超过上限（参数或索引自带）时抛 SeekError。
    """
    if not index.entries:
        raise SeekError("空索引，无法定位")
    limit = _limit_of(index, max_backoff_ms)
    keys = index._keys

    if t_ms < keys[0]:
        c = index.entries[0][1]
        return {
            "start_ms": c.start_ms,
            "end_ms": c.end_ms,
            "offset": c.offset,
            "size": c.size,
            "backoff_ms": 0,
            "boundary": "before_first",
        }

    i = bisect.bisect_right(keys, t_ms) - 1
    boundary = None
    if i == len(keys) - 1 and t_ms >= index.entries[-1][1].end_ms:
        boundary = "after_last"
    c = index.entries[i][1]
    backoff = t_ms - c.start_ms
    if limit is not None and backoff > limit:
        raise SeekError(
            "回退偏差 %d ms 超过上限 %d ms（请求时刻 %d）"
            % (backoff, limit, t_ms)
        )
    return {
        "start_ms": c.start_ms,
        "end_ms": c.end_ms,
        "offset": c.offset,
        "size": c.size,
        "backoff_ms": backoff,
        "boundary": boundary,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 落盘 / 读回
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def load_chunks(path):
    """从 JSON 文件读入块列表，返回 list[Chunk]。"""
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return [_coerce_chunk(d) for d in data]


def save_index(index, path):
    """索引落盘（JSON，键排序，保证字节级确定）。"""
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(index.to_dict(), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        f.write("\n")


def load_index(path):
    """读回落盘的索引；读回后 seek 结果与内存索引完全一致。"""
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return Index.from_dict(json.load(f))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 多级索引
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _block_id(raw, c, i):
    """块的对外标识：优先 path，其次 offset，最后序号。"""
    if isinstance(raw, dict) and "path" in raw:
        return raw["path"]
    if isinstance(raw, dict) and "id" in raw:
        return raw["id"]
    if c.offset:
        return c.offset
    return i


class TieredIndex:
    """多级索引：level 0 放全部块起点，更高层每 fanout 个取一个稀疏锚点。"""

    def __init__(self, blocks, fanout):
        # blocks: list of (start_ms, end_ms, block_id)，已按 start_ms 升序去重
        self.blocks = blocks
        self.fanout = fanout
        # levels[0] 为底层（全部块起点），levels[-1] 为最稀疏的顶层
        self.levels = []
        level = list(range(len(blocks)))  # 存块下标
        self.levels.append(level)
        while len(level) > 1:
            level = level[::fanout]
            if len(level) == 1 and len(self.levels[-1]) == 1:
                break
            self.levels.append(level)
            if len(level) == 1:
                break

    # -- 内部 ------------------------------------------------------------
    def _key(self, lvl, pos):
        return self.blocks[self.levels[lvl][pos]][0]

    def _descend(self, t_ms):
        """从顶层逐级下降，返回 (块下标, 跨级数)。"""
        n_levels = len(self.levels)
        # 顶层：找不晚于 t 的锚点
        top = self.levels[-1]
        keys = [self.blocks[b][0] for b in top]
        i = bisect.bisect_right(keys, t_ms) - 1
        if i < 0:
            i = 0
        lo_block = top[i]
        # 下一层的搜索范围：[i*fanout, (i+1)*fanout)
        lo = i * self.fanout
        hi = lo + self.fanout
        for lvl in range(n_levels - 2, -1, -1):
            level = self.levels[lvl]
            lo = min(lo, len(level) - 1)
            hi = min(hi, len(level))
            keys = [self.blocks[b][0] for b in level[lo:hi]]
            j = bisect.bisect_right(keys, t_ms) - 1
            if j < 0:
                j = 0
            block_idx = level[lo + j]
            # 计算更下一层的范围
            lo = (lo + j) * self.fanout
            hi = lo + self.fanout
            lo_block = block_idx
        return lo_block, n_levels

    # -- 对外 ------------------------------------------------------------
    def seek(self, t_ms):
        if not self.blocks:
            raise SeekError("空索引，无法定位")
        starts = [b[0] for b in self.blocks]
        if t_ms < starts[0]:
            start, end, bid = self.blocks[0]
            return {
                "block": bid,
                "start_ms": start,
                "end_ms": end,
                "backoff_ms": 0,
                "levels": len(self.levels),
                "boundary": "before_first",
            }
        idx, n_levels = self._descend(t_ms)
        start, end, bid = self.blocks[idx]
        boundary = None
        if idx == len(self.blocks) - 1 and t_ms >= end:
            boundary = "after_last"
        return {
            "block": bid,
            "start_ms": start,
            "end_ms": end,
            "backoff_ms": t_ms - start,
            "levels": n_levels,
            "boundary": boundary,
        }

    def stats(self):
        return {
            "entries": sum(len(l) for l in self.levels),
            "levels": len(self.levels),
            "chunks": len(self.blocks),
        }


def build_tiered_index(chunks, fanout=8):
    """多级索引：返回索引对象，含 levels 与 entries。

    底层放全部块起点；更高层每 fanout 个条目取一个稀疏锚点。
    重复 start_ms 按出现顺序取第一个。
    """
    if fanout < 2:
        raise ValueError("fanout 必须 >= 2")
    seen = set()
    blocks = []
    for i, raw in enumerate(chunks):
        c = _coerce_chunk(raw)
        if c.start_ms in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(c.start_ms)
        blocks.append((c.start_ms, c.end_ms, _block_id(raw, c, i)))
    blocks.sort(key=lambda b: b[0])
    return TieredIndex(blocks, fanout)


def seek_in(index, t_ms):
    """定位落点：返回 dict(block=块标识, backoff_ms=回退毫秒, levels=跨级数)。"""
    return index.seek(t_ms)


def seek_many(index, times):
    """批量定位：返回 list(dict)，与逐个 seek_in 完全一致。"""
    return [index.seek(t) for t in times]


def index_stats(index):
    """返回 dict(entries=条目数, levels=级数, chunks=块数)。"""
    return index.stats()

    """找不晚于该时刻的键；早于首点时返回 None。"""
    if not index.entries:
        return None
    i = bisect.bisect_right(index._keys, t_ms) - 1
    if i < 0:
        return None
    return index._keys[i]


def _limit_of(index, max_backoff_ms):
    return index.max_backoff_ms if max_backoff_ms is None else max_backoff_ms


def seek_time(index, t_ms, max_backoff_ms=None):
    """返回落点与偏差。

    命中规则：只回退到不晚于 t_ms 的关键点。
    返回 dict(start_ms, end_ms, offset, size, backoff_ms, boundary)。
    boundary 为 None / "before_first" / "after_last"。
    回退偏差超过上限（参数或索引自带）时抛 SeekError。
    """

        raise SeekError("空索引，无法定位")
    limit = _limit_of(index, max_backoff_ms)
    keys = index._keys

    if t_ms < keys[0]:
        c = index.entries[0][1]
        return {
            "start_ms": c.start_ms,
            "end_ms": c.end_ms,
            "offset": c.offset,
            "size": c.size,
            "backoff_ms": 0,
            "boundary": "before_first",

    i = bisect.bisect_right(keys, t_ms) - 1
    boundary = None
    if i == len(keys) - 1 and t_ms >= index.entries[-1][1].end_ms:

    c = index.entries[i][1]

    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _block_id(raw, c, i):
    """块的对外标识：优先 path，其次 offset，最后序号。"""
    if isinstance(raw, dict) and "path" in raw:
        return raw["path"]
    if isinstance(raw, dict) and "id" in raw:
        return raw["id"]
    if c.offset:
        return c.offset
    return i


class TieredIndex:
    """多级索引：level 0 放全部块起点，更高层每 fanout 个取一个稀疏锚点。"""

    def __init__(self, blocks, fanout):
        # blocks: list of (start_ms, end_ms, block_id)，已按 start_ms 升序去重
        self.blocks = blocks
        self.fanout = fanout
        # levels[0] 为底层（全部块起点），levels[-1] 为最稀疏的顶层
        self.levels = []
        level = list(range(len(blocks)))  # 存块下标
        self.levels.append(level)
        while len(level) > 1:
            level = level[::fanout]
            if len(level) == 1 and len(self.levels[-1]) == 1:
                break
            self.levels.append(level)
            if len(level) == 1:
                break

    # -- 内部 ------------------------------------------------------------
    def _key(self, lvl, pos):
        return self.blocks[self.levels[lvl][pos]][0]

    def _descend(self, t_ms):
        """从顶层逐级下降，返回 (块下标, 跨级数)。"""
        n_levels = len(self.levels)

        top = self.levels[-1]
        keys = [self.blocks[b][0] for b in top]
        i = bisect.bisect_right(keys, t_ms) - 1
        if i < 0:

        lo_block = top[i]
        # 下一层的搜索范围：[i*fanout, (i+1)*fanout)
        lo = i * self.fanout
        hi = lo + self.fanout
        for lvl in range(n_levels - 2, -1, -1):
            level = self.levels[lvl]
            lo = min(lo, len(level) - 1)
            hi = min(hi, len(level))
            keys = [self.blocks[b][0] for b in level[lo:hi]]
            j = bisect.bisect_right(keys, t_ms) - 1
            if j < 0:

            block_idx = level[lo + j]

            hi = lo + self.fanout
            lo_block = block_idx

    # -- 对外 ------------------------------------------------------------

        starts = [b[0] for b in self.blocks]
        if t_ms < starts[0]:

            return {
                "block": bid,
                "start_ms": start,
                "end_ms": end,
                "backoff_ms": 0,
                "levels": len(self.levels),
                "boundary": "before_first",
            }
        idx, n_levels = self._descend(t_ms)
        start, end, bid = self.blocks[idx]
        boundary = None
        if idx == len(self.blocks) - 1 and t_ms >= end:
            boundary = "after_last"
        return {
            "block": bid,
            "start_ms": start,
            "end_ms": end,
            "backoff_ms": t_ms - start,
            "levels": n_levels,
            "boundary": boundary,
        }

    def stats(self):
        return {
            "entries": sum(len(l) for l in self.levels),
            "levels": len(self.levels),
            "chunks": len(self.blocks),
        }


def build_tiered_index(chunks, fanout=8):
    """多级索引：返回索引对象，含 levels 与 entries。

    底层放全部块起点；更高层每 fanout 个条目取一个稀疏锚点。
    重复 start_ms 按出现顺序取第一个。

    return [index.seek(t) for t in times]


def index_stats(index):
